origin: cwe/787/cpp Key Principles: std::span carries the real size; do not trust a separate caller-provided length

finding.name: Out-of-bounds Write
finding.summary: The writer receives a std::span but validates the index against a separate advertised capacity, then writes through unchecked span::operator[].

trap: Replacing the caller's advertisedLength check with another separate length parameter, or using span.subspan(index) without checking its preconditions. The fix must validate index against segment.size() inside the callee.
must_preserve: Valid writes within the actual span still update the requested byte, out-of-range indices are reported or rejected, and callers no longer need to pass a claimed capacity that can disagree with the span.
